preserved: Six selected complete answers across three conditions and two platforms
All ten actual submissions, including four earlier failed or incomplete ChatGPT C attempts
Registered prompts, model/time/search evidence, recovery summaries and reviewer judgments
Original target post identity, exact excerpt and public body evidence
Answer URLs and domains, included/excluded source roles and recorded C/M/R observations
removed: Private ChatGPT/Grok conversation and share URLs, including ChatGPT /s/ URLs
Private conversation/message identifiers, automation and browser operation identifiers
Original account screenshots, full DOM/HTML, native tool exports and local archives
Local filesystem paths and links to private capture files
Original account preference values and unrelated navigation/consent links
Tracking parameters in public source URLs
not_published_as_source_results: Unscoped full-page anchor inventories are retained locally. Their entries and source badge totals must not be interpreted as citation counts.
manual_C_answer: The public answer_text is the user-supplied complete English paste, corroborated against the complete original native message. Formatting and citation representations differ; eleven URLs are preserved separately. The private native dump is excluded.
controls: Manual ChatGPT C model and approximate time are user-confirmed; pre-submit temporary/personalization controls were not independently captured. Full answer collection is not proof of identical control evidence.
external_claims: Study statistics and verified labels in platform answers are platform claims; this stage did not independently audit those studies.
scope: Only public copies are redacted; local originals and all historical failures remain unchanged. Outcomes and recommendation roles are preserved.
language_policy: Documentation and annotations are English. Original English answers and questions retain their wording apart from marked privacy edits and tracking removal. Captured non-English UI tokens use literal Unicode escapes.
